quarterly_data.quarter: GlobalFoundries press release: GlobalFoundries announces customer availability of UX (09-02-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: At its GF Technology Summit, GF announced process design kit (PDK) availability for its UX platform family: 40nm (40UX) and 22nm (22UX) feature-rich CMOS technologies for ultra-low power microcontrollers, wireless connectivity, sensor interfaces, imaging and edge AI (Physical AI). 40UX builds on GF's 40nm eFlash platform (more than one million wafers shipped to date) and is set to ramp to volume production at GF's Singapore site by 2027, with future production planned at Malta, New York. 22UX is an analog-optimized 22nm platform (developed from GF's 28nm technology, over one million wafers shipped to date) to be manufactured in Dresden, Germany, with a roadmap to multi-site production. Both are available for prototyping through GlobalShuttle multi-project wafers with quarterly shuttles scheduled through 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: 40UX volume production at Singapore by 2027; 22UX in Dresden; quarterly shuttles through 2027
